lead: The options have similar meanings but belong to different word classes: although, despite, however. What comes after the blank decides the class: a clause, a noun, or a comma.
選項意思相近但詞性不同，例如 although、despite、however。空格後面接什麼（子句、名詞或逗號）決定該用哪一類。
steps: Look at what follows the blank: a full clause, a noun or -ing phrase, or a comma after a full stop.
看空格後面：完整子句、名詞或 Ving，還是句號後面接逗號。
Pick the word class that fits that shape.
選出符合這個形狀的詞類。
Among words of that class, choose by meaning: contrast, reason, time, condition, addition or purpose.
同一類的字裡，再用意思選：對比、原因、時間、條件、補充或目的。

head: A clause follows: conjunction
後面接子句：連接詞
body: A clause has its own subject and verb. Conjunctions that introduce one: although, because, while, unless, as soon as, so that.
子句有自己的主詞和動詞。引導子句的連接詞：although、because、while、unless、as soon as、so that。
ex: Although the budget was limited, the project was completed on time.
雖然預算有限，計畫仍準時完成。
You will not receive a refund unless you keep the receipt.
除非你保留收據，否則無法退款。

head: A noun or -ing follows: preposition
後面接名詞或 Ving：介系詞
body: Prepositions take a noun or an -ing form, never a clause: despite, because of, due to, during, prior to, in addition to.
介系詞後面接名詞或 -ing，不接子句：despite、because of、due to、during、prior to、in addition to。
ex: Despite the limited budget, the project was completed on time.
儘管預算有限，計畫仍準時完成。
Prior to joining our company, Mr. Kim worked in marketing.
加入本公司之前，金先生從事行銷工作。
In addition to managing the team, Ms. Ortiz handles several client accounts.
除了管理團隊，Ortiz 女士也負責幾個客戶。

head: After a full stop or semicolon: linking adverb
句號或分號後：連接副詞
body: However, therefore, as a result and meanwhile link two sentences, usually followed by a comma. They cannot join two clauses with only a comma.
however、therefore、as a result、meanwhile 連接兩個句子，後面通常有逗號。不能只用逗號連接兩個子句。
ex: The budget was limited; however, the project was completed on time.
預算有限，然而計畫仍準時完成。
Sales dropped in March. As a result, the company revised its forecast.
三月銷售下滑，因此公司修正了預測。
The printer is being repaired. In the meantime, please use the one on the second floor.
印表機正在維修，這段期間請使用二樓那台。

head: A blank at the start of a sentence
空格在句首
body: Read the sentence before it and decide how the two relate. Opposite: however. Result: therefore, as a result. Extra point: in addition, moreover. Order in time: afterward, meanwhile.
先讀前一句，判斷兩句的關係。相反用 however，結果用 therefore、as a result，補充用 in addition、moreover，時間順序用 afterward、meanwhile。
ex: The old system was slow. Therefore, the team installed a new one.
舊系統很慢，所以團隊安裝了新系統。
Ms. Cruz handles billing. In addition, she trains new staff.
Cruz 女士負責帳務，此外她也訓練新進員工。

head: Reason: because or because of
原因：because 或 because of
body: Because takes a clause. Because of, due to and owing to take a noun. Since and as can also give a reason when a clause follows.
because 接子句；because of、due to、owing to 接名詞。since 和 as 後面接子句時也可以表示原因。
ex: The flight was delayed because of heavy fog.
航班因為濃霧而延誤。
The flight was delayed because the fog was heavy.
航班延誤是因為霧很濃。

head: Time: while or during
時間：while 或 during
body: While, when and once take a clause. During, prior to and following take a noun. Before, after and until work with both.
while、when、once 接子句；during、prior to、following 接名詞；before、after、until 兩種都可以。
ex: Please turn off your phone during the presentation.
簡報期間請關機。
Please turn off your phone while the presentation is in progress.
簡報進行時請關機。

head: Condition, purpose and whether
條件、目的與 whether
body: Unless means if not. So that gives a purpose and takes a clause; in order to takes a base verb. Whether ... or not means regardless of the answer.
unless 是 if not。so that 表示目的，接子句；in order to 接原形動詞。whether ... or not 表示不論結果。
ex: Whether you attend in person or online, please register in advance.
無論你是親自出席還是線上參加，都請提前報名。
Please arrive early so that the session can start on time.
請提早到，這樣場次才能準時開始。

pairs.right: Despite the rain, the event continued.
pairs.wrong: Despite it rained, the event continued.
why: Despite is a preposition and cannot take a clause. For a clause, use although.
despite 是介系詞，後面不能接子句。要接子句就改用 although。

pairs.right: Even though the store was busy, the staff stayed calm.
pairs.wrong: Even the store was busy, the staff stayed calm.
why: Even is an adverb and cannot join clauses. Use even though or even if.
even 是副詞，不能連接子句，要用 even though 或 even if。

pairs.right: The store closed early due to the storm.
pairs.wrong: The store closed early due to the storm was coming.
why: Due to is a preposition, so only a noun can follow it.
due to 是介系詞，後面只能接名詞。

pairs.right: The budget was limited. However, the project was completed.
pairs.wrong: The budget was limited, however the project was completed.
why: However cannot join two clauses with a comma. Use a full stop or a semicolon.
however 不能用逗號連接兩個子句，要用句號或分號。

head: Reason and result
原因與結果
items: because of, due to, owing to + noun

head: Time
時間
items: when, while, once, as soon as + clause
before, after, until + clause or noun

head: Condition and addition
條件與補充
items: if, unless, provided that, as long as + clause
in addition to, besides, as well as + noun

traps: Before, after and until work as both conjunction and preposition. Look at what follows, not at the word.
before、after、until 既是連接詞也是介系詞。看後面接什麼，不要看這個字本身。
Since can mean from a time until now, or because. A point in time after it suggests the first; a reason suggests the second.
since 可以是「自從」或「因為」。後面是時間點通常是前者，是理由通常是後者。
Although and despite mean the same. When two options share a meaning, the shape after the blank is the only difference, so check that first.
although 和 despite 意思相同。兩個選項意思一樣時，差別只在空格後面的形狀，先看這個。
